# Modernization Workbook

A clean, standalone project for federal IT modernization. Content is written for reuse without internal branding or source-system identifiers.

## What lives here

- **[SQL Server Identity Transformation](docs/case-studies/sql-server-narrative/series-overview.md)** — an eleven-book reading sequence on moving from Windows Authentication to cloud identity authentication for SQL Server.
- **[Client-Server to Hybrid-Cloud](docs/client-server-to-hybrid-cloud/00-the-problem.md)** — the architectural narrative of the modernization journey.
- **[Whitepapers](docs/whitepapers/README.md)** — long-form analyses of specific modernization topics.
- **[Principles](docs/PRINCIPLES.md)** — the governing ideas that shape the work.
- **[Compliance Series](docs/compliance/federal-compliance-series-moderate/executive-summary.md)** — federal compliance documentation organized by volume.
- **[Case Studies](docs/case-studies/README.md)** — deployment patterns and lessons learned.
- **[Executive Briefs](docs/executive-briefs/modernization-overview.md)** — single-page leadership summaries.

## Download as DOCX

Every page renders to Microsoft Word (`.docx`) alongside the HTML view. Access the DOCX directly (e.g., `docs/case-studies/sql-server-narrative/series-overview.docx`).

Complete series are available as ZIP downloads:

- [SQL Server Narrative Series](downloads/sql-server-narrative-series.zip)
- [Client-Server to Hybrid-Cloud Series](downloads/client-server-to-hybrid-cloud-series.zip)
